title: DFIR Madness Case001: desktop-only workflow smoke
instructions: Only the explicitly configured desktop disk image is supplied. No server image, memory capture or network capture is supplied.
This is an operational smoke using a revised six-question scope. There is no frozen expected-answer reference and no question-accuracy score.
Use supplied records and certified findings; explicitly mark unknowns and keep judgments separate. Do not consult solution pages or reference files.
Preserve recorded timestamp meanings. Report clock uncertainty without silently shifting source timestamps to fit another timeline.
No broad absence, completeness, compromise, attribution, intent or exfiltration claim follows merely from a missing extracted record.

questions.prompt: Identify the recorded computer name, operating-system version and timezone configuration. Distinguish recorded settings from a corrected real-world clock.
Identify recorded accounts and supported logon/logoff activity. Do not infer that an account caused every associated event.
Report supported application execution or registration observations, preserving each timestamp meaning and artifact source.
Report supported browser visits and downloads with source artifacts and recorded timestamps. State unavailable evidence explicitly.
Report supported file paths, hashes, or historical name observations. Distinguish identical content, rename identity and stronger intent conclusions.
Describe reader failures, unsupported artifacts, uninspected sources and unresolved questions for this desktop-only smoke.
